title: Generation of Neural Stem Cells Derived Organoids (NSCO)
author: Valeria Fernandez Vallone
materials: REAGENTS PREPARATION Neural Induction Supplement ( 10 mL ) Thaw Neural Induction Supplement overnight at 4 °C . Aliquot in working volumes (e.g. 1 mL ) and store at -20 °C . Do not freeze-thaw more than once. B27 supplement (50X) Thaw B27 supplement Overnight at 4 °C . Make aliquots in working volumes (e.g. 1 mL ) and store at -20 °C . Do not freeze-thaw more than twice. Human EGF To prepare a 10 µg/mL stock solution from 50 µg Human EGF, dissolve 50 µg EGF in 5 mL PBS containing 0.1% BSA. Make aliquots in working volumes (e.g. 100 µL ) and store at -80 °C . Do not freeze-thaw more than twice. Human FGF-basic To prepare a 10 µg/mL stock solution from 50 µg Human FGF-basic, dissolve 50 µg FGF-basic in 5 mL PBS containing 0.1% BSA. Make aliquots in working volumes (e.g. 100 µL ) and store at -80 °C . Do not freeze-thaw more than twice. NT3 To prepare 20 µg/mL stock from 100 µg NT3, dissolve 100 µg NT3 in 5 mL PBS containing 0.1% BSA. Make aliquots in working volumes (e.g. 100 µL ) and store at -80 °C . Do not freeze-thaw more than twice. BDNF To prepare 20 µg/mL stock from 100 µg BDNF, dissolve 100 µg BDNF in 5 mL PBS containing 0.1% BSA. Make aliquots in working volumes (e.g. 100 µL ) and store at -80 °C . Do not freeze-thaw more than twice.

steps.title: Prepare Neural Expansion Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare Neural Expansion Medium (NEM) exactly as described in Table 1.

steps.title: Prepare Neural Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare Neural Medium (NM) exactly as described in Table 2.

steps.title: Prepare Supplemented NDM
steps.instruction: Prepare Neural Differentiation Medium (NDM) supplemented with BDNF and NT3 according to Table 3.

steps.title: Thaw and Resuspend NSCs
steps.instruction: Thaw NSCs from a quality‑controlled bank, resuspend in 2 mL NEM containing 10 µM ROCK inhibitor, and count viability with Trypan Blue; viability must be >70‑80 % for good sphere formation.

steps.title: Seed NSCs in 96‑well Plate
steps.instruction: Seed 7 500 NSCs per well of a 96‑well round‑bottom ultra‑low attachment plate in 100 µL NEM with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor; a suspension of 75 000 cells in 10 mL NEM is sufficient for one plate.

steps.title: Centrifuge Plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 300 × g for 1 minute to induce faster cell sedimentation.

steps.title: Incubate Initial Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 24 hours.

steps.title: Assess Sphere Formation
steps.instruction: Observe spheres under a microscope; if no compact sphere forms, discard the plate and restart. If satellite spheres are present, incubate an additional 24 hours without perturbation and allow possible fusion. Count as Day 1 when the media is changed. If spheres do not fuse, discard and restart.

steps.title: Switch to Neural Medium
steps.instruction: Aspirate 50 µL medium from each well and add 100 µL fresh NM per well using an 8‑channel pipette, tilting the plate and dispensing with a multi‑step dispenser at medium speed; verify that spheres are not carried away.

steps.title: Media Change to Supplemented NDM
steps.instruction: Aspirate 100 µL from each well and add 150 µL fresh supplemented NDM.

steps.title: Day 2 and Day 4 Changes
steps.instruction: On Days 2 and 4, aspirate 100 µL from each well and add 100 µL fresh NM.

steps.title: Day 6‑15 Alternate‑Day Changes
steps.instruction: From Day 6 to Day 15, perform media changes every other day by aspirating 150 µL from each well and adding 150 µL fresh supplemented NDM. Optional: on Fridays add 200‑250 µL total volume for a weekend‑free interval; on the following Monday aspirate the same 200‑250 µL volume.

steps.title: Day 15 Decision Point
steps.instruction: On Day 15 decide whether to keep cultures static or switch to dynamic conditions and follow the corresponding branch.

steps.title: Static Culture Maintenance
steps.instruction: If static, continue alternate‑day media changes as in the previous step (150 µL exchange) while keeping plates stationary in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator; apply the optional Friday weekend‑free volume as described. Continue until the endpoint at Day 30.

steps.title: Transfer to Dynamic Format
steps.instruction: If dynamic, on Day 15 transfer NSCO from the 96‑well plate to larger wells using 200 µL bore tips to avoid disruption. Choose a format from Table 4 (e.g., 6‑well plate up to 12 NSCO per well with 4 mL NDM, or 10 cm dish up to 48 NSCO per well with 15 mL NDM). Optionally add 1 % extracellular matrix such as Matrigel. Avoid stirring flasks.

steps.title: Place on Orbital Shaker
steps.instruction: Place the dynamic culture plates or dishes on an orbital shaker set to 65 rpm and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Dynamic Medium Changes
steps.instruction: Change the medium twice per week using the volumes specified in Table 4 with supplemented NDM, continuing this schedule until Day 45.

steps.title: Long‑Term Maintenance
steps.instruction: From Day 45 onward, switch the medium to NDM without BDNF or NT3 for long‑term maintenance; continue medium changes as in the previous step. Removal of NT3 and BDNF reduces cost without altering NSCO composition; decide based on experimental design.

steps.title: General Culture Conditions
steps.instruction: Maintain all cultures at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ throughout. It is recommended to keep NSCO under static conditions until Day 30; if extension beyond Day 45 is required, perform medium changes as described in the dynamic‑culture steps, using NDM with or without BDNF/NT3 as desired. Document growth by taking pictures and measuring size increase, which should be exponential until Day 15.
